Not blocking (1), ordering: documentBuildingFor and the external API pick the 'first object' with officeJournalTarget (office-journals.ts:20-25, a JS sort using localeCompare(name, 'ru')). The transfer (office-journals.server.ts:56-60) and the header list (active-building.ts listOrganizationBuildings) use the database ORDER BY sortOrder, name. If objects have equal sortOrder (the default is 0) and their names collate differently, for example Latin vs Cyrillic, case under C collation, or quotes, new documents that reach a helper or the external API with the office id land on a different object than the transferred office journals. Repro: org 'Cafe Mira' + 'Кафе' + office. The header order and the transfer target are 'Cafe Mira', while documentBuildingFor and ensureActiveDocument(office) give 'Кафе'. The local DB uses C.UTF-8; en-US/und ICU order the same way. The documents are never on the office. Smallest fix: in documentBuildingFor, take db.building.findFirst({ where: { organizationId, NOT: { kind: 'office' } }, orderBy: [{ sortOrder: 'asc' }, { name: 'asc' }] }) like the transfer. In dispatch.ts:795, take the first non-office building of the already DB-ordered list.

Not blocking (2): the equipment-calibration copy action («Сделать копию») at «Выберите объект» toasts «Проверьте введённые данные», because calibrationErrorKey maps 400 to 'invalid' (equipment-calibration-presentation.ts:49, client :150-178). It is a menu action, not a create window, and other copy actions show the server text. Smallest fix: map payload.code === 'point_required' to journalControls.documentDialog.pointRequired.
